AlignmentCondition.description:
Unsafe when a variable strays from a target variable by ``tolerance`` or more.

For example a beam position compared against its reference setpoint.

kind.description: Condition type. 'alignment' compares a variable with a target variable.
kind.title: Kind

target_device.description: Device carrying the target variable (default: the same device).
target_device.title: Target Device

tolerance.description: UNSAFE when |value - target| is this large or larger (in the variable's units).
tolerance.title: Tolerance

hysteresis.description: How much closer than the tolerance the value must come before the interlock counts as safe again.
hysteresis.title: Hysteresis

AlignmentCondition.title: AlignmentCondition

Interlock.description: One interlock: a name and the condition that makes it unsafe.

name.description: Short name shown to operators and on the status stream.
name.title: Name

description.description: Optional note on what this interlock protects.
description.title: Description

enabled.description: Set false to keep the entry without arming it (shown as not armed, never counted in the verdict).
enabled.title: Enabled

condition.description: The condition that makes this interlock unsafe.
condition.title: Condition

settle_s.description: Seconds the condition must stay safe after a trip before the interlock reports OK again.
settle_s.title: Settle S

Interlock.title: Interlock

StaleCondition.description:
Unsafe when a device stops publishing.

Always unsafe while the device's subscription is disconnected.  With
``max_age_s`` it is also unsafe when no new update has arrived from the
device for that long — only meaningful for a free-running device that
keeps publishing between shots.

kind.description: Condition type. 'stale' trips when a device stops publishing.
kind.title: Kind

max_age_s.description: Seconds without a new update before the device counts as stale. Leave empty to trip only on a disconnect.
max_age_s.title: Max Age S

StaleCondition.title: StaleCondition

ThresholdCondition.description:
Unsafe when a variable crosses a limit.

For example ``operator: '>'`` with ``limit: 4094`` trips when a camera's
``MaxCounts`` saturates.

kind.description: Condition type. 'threshold' compares one variable to a limit.
kind.title: Kind

operator.description: The reading is UNSAFE when 'value <operator> limit' holds, e.g. '>' trips above the limit.
operator.title: Operator

limit.description: The limit the reading is compared against.
limit.title: Limit

hysteresis.description: How far back past the limit the reading must come before the interlock counts as safe again (0 = resume as soon as it is back).
hysteresis.title: Hysteresis

ThresholdCondition.title: ThresholdCondition

description:
The experiment's software interlocks, watched by the interlock server.

Notes
-----
Stored as ``interlocks.yaml`` at the top of the experiment's scanner
configs.  The interlock server reads it at start and on a reload from
its window; an edit takes effect at the next reload.
